author: Elvin
description: Create memes from a huge, constantly updated library of templates. Browse templates through a paginated, searchable embed with buttons and a dropdown, then fill in the meme text through modals (chained automatically for templates that need more than 5 lines of text).
install_msg: Thanks for installing MemeForge! Run `[p]memeforge` to browse templates and start creating memes. Templates are pulled live from memegen.link If you enjoy my cogs and wish to support me then please consider donating via [Ko-Fi](https://ko-fi.com/dasvino)!
short: Create memes from countless templates using an interactive browser and modals.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data. The text you type into meme creation modals is sent to the third-party memegen.link API solely to generate the requested meme image URL, and is not persisted by this cog.
